Methodological definitions form the backbone of quality assurance and reporting within the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK) and the broader [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP). These definitions ensure that clinical indicators and patient registries are measured consistently across different reporting periods, allowing health authorities to accurately track the quality of atrial fibrillation care in Denmark.

A central methodological definition pertains to the completeness of patient registration. In both the 2024 and 2025 reporting frameworks, completeness is strictly defined as the number of patients with atrial fibrillation registered in the database divided by the total number of patients with atrial fibrillation [^src1] [^src3]. This metric is crucial for evaluating the database's coverage and reliability. Furthermore, the scope of the reporting is explicitly limited to patients who possess a Danish CPR number and reside in Denmark, a criterion that inherently relies on data from the [[cpr-registeret|CPR-registeret]] to define the eligible patient population [^src4].

Additionally, when evaluating clinical indicators over time, the reports define "Tidligere år (95% CI)" (Previous years) as the indicator value from prior reporting periods, allowing for longitudinal comparisons with statistical confidence intervals [^src2]. Together, these methodological definitions establish a rigorous, standardized framework for tracking and improving cardiovascular healthcare quality.

## Claims

- Komplethedsgraden af patientregistreringen i AFDK defineres som: antal patienter med atrieflimren i databasen / total antal patienter med atrieflimren [^src3] (databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark)
  Type: methodological-definition
  Page: 68
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 66-70
- Tidligere år (95% CI): Angiver indikatorværdi i forrige opgørelsesperioder [^src1] (regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram)
  Type: methodological-definition
  Page: 111
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 111-113
- Komplethedsgraden af patientregistreringen i AFDK defineres som: antal patienter med atrieflimren i databasen / total antal patienter med atrieflimren. [^src1] (databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark)

  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2025.pdf, pages 61-65
